profile.headline: Senior Backend Engineer @ Netflix
profile.summary: Backend engineer with 10+ years building distributed systems at Netflix, Tinder, Thumbtack, and Riot Games. I focus on event-driven services, streaming pipelines, and systems where reliability really matters. I’ve built trust & safety detection systems, ML retraining pipelines, and high-throughput datastores. I'm looking for full-time, remote senior+ backend roles at product-focused companies.

positions.title: Personal goal pursuit
positions.description:
- Traveled internationally (Italy, Iceland, SE Asia) and became a certified Master Gardener and Scuba Diver
- Pursuing personal technical projects

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Owned backend services supporting customer engagement features that drive user retention and feature adoption
- Designed and implemented an Airflow-based automated retraining pipeline for top-of-funnel ML models

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer | Trust & Safety
positions.description:
- System Scaling: Launched a centralized trust-signal datastore scaling to 10K+ writes/sec while improving read latency by 10x.
- Streaming Architecture: Built Flink-based stream processors to detect fraud patterns and remove tens of thousands of bad actors daily.
- SME & Team Lead: Led a team of 6 engineers building real-time detection services for global abuse and policy violations.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer | Legends of Runeterra
positions.description:
- Designed event-driven services with retries and throttling so the game stayed stable during spikes and downstream outages
- Implemented load-testing framework and scaled game throughput 100x
- Served as tech lead for features such as matchmaking and quests

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented infrastructure automation, driving migration from physical hardware to cloud-based infrastructure
- Built and maintained internal backend services used by Riot engineering teams

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Served as tech lead for two automotive GPS devices
